page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top centre; page number top left; signature at foot left. Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words interspersed with Latin, large Hebrew-letter headwords at the left of entries.

main_text.p: di. Fœmin. דְּכְיָא Pura, munda; דְּמְתִילָא לִיונְתָא דְּכִיתָא; Quæ similis es columbæ afflictæ, attritæ, Cant.2.14. potius ad דּךְ pertinet, & leg. דְּכִיתָא. Plur. דְּכִין.
יְכִּין Syr. Idem. Plur. יְכִּין Johan.13.10.
יְכִּין Syr. Purgatio, mundatio: secessus, latrina, Marc.7.19.
מִדְכּוּתָא Ch. Idem. Esth.3.8. in Targ.sec.
דְּכִין Chald. vide supra in דּוּר.
דָּךְ Hinc Geminatum Pahel דְּכַּךְ Atterere, conterere, contundere. Vide quoque דּוּךְ.
דְּכִיךְ Ch. Attritus, contritus, Fœmin. דְּכִיכְתָּא.
דְּכֵין Ch. Hic, iste, Hæc, ista, Idem quod הַדֵּין, צַלְמָא דְּכֵין, Imago ista, Dan.2.31. קַרְנָא דְּכֵין Cornu istud, Daniel.7.21.
דּוּכְנָא דּוּכֵן Ch. Suggestum, suggestus, cathedra. Plur. דּוּכְנִי, דּוּכְנִין.
דְּכָס דּוּכָס Ch. Dux. Plur. דּוּכְסִין Duces, const. דּוּכְסֵי, Cant.6.7. Esth.5.10.
דְּכַר Ch. & Syr. Recordari, meminisse, memorem esse. Hebr. זָכַר. Ithpehal אִדְּכַר. Syr. ܐܬܕܟܪ Idem. Item Memorari, comemorari. Ethpah. ܐܬܕܟܰܪ Idé.
Aphel אַדְכַּר Ch. & Syr. Recordari facere, Memorare, commemorare, In memoriam revocare.
דִּכְרָא דְּכַר Ch. ܕܟܪܐ Syr. Mas, masculus: Item, Aries. Plur. דְּכְרִין, emp. דִּכְרַיָּא, Syr. ܕܟܪܐ Masculi: Arietes.

page.notes: The Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee forms are reproduced approximately from a small, faded scan; vowel points and diacritics over several Syriac words are uncertain and may differ from the print. The Hebrew headwords in large type at the left are copied as best read.
